rules.statement: An instrument is chargeable with duty when it falls within the character which it purports to have, apart from any question as to whether or not it is effective for the purpose.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion an instrument is chargeable with duty when it falls within the character which it purports to have, apart from any question as to whether or not it is effective for the purpose."

meta.parties: In Re Application of v. Coomarasamy
